DeterminationBasis: Existing T05 controls establish evidence identity, provenance, admissibility, integrity and re-hashability, but no existing T05 control requires the implementation to identify material trust boundaries relevant to the declared conformance scope. A distinct trust-boundary identification test is therefore required.

T05-003 explicitly falsifies conflation of authentication or integrity with truth and governance admissibility. It requires authentication to remain only one evidentiary property and prevents authentication alone from establishing truth, relevance or authority. This directly covers SEC-004.
